title: Arkret Invite Delivery
description: Actor-private plaintext account-data typed current result value containing delivered directed-invite references and untrusted authority-bundle locator hints. It is not part of Realm history and carries no bearer credential.

updated_at.description: Instant of the accepted CAS write that produced this value.

delivery_entries.description: Bounded register of delivered directed invites, oldest first. At most one entry per invite_id; a redelivery of the same invite_id replaces the previous entry. Entries whose expires_at has passed are purged on the next write; overflow beyond 200 evicts the oldest entries.

invite_id.description: Invite ID derived from the accepted ak.invite.create Event; the deduplication key of this register.

inviter_account_id.description: Complete AccountId of the inviter, copied from the accepted invite Event and verified by the delivery chain.

authority_locator_hints.description: One to eight untrusted locator cores, strictly sorted by service_id UTF-8 bytes. service_id is the semantic identity key; duplicate or conflicting representations of one service_id invalidate the entire array. The invitee's own Station must fetch and verify a nonce-bound RealmAuthorityBundle before any preview, join preparation, or bootstrap request.

received_at.description: Instant the recipient Station accepted this delivery into the typed current result.

expires_at.description: Expiry copied from the accepted invite; an entry with expires_at <= now is stale and MUST NOT be used to accept the invite.
